aggressive_lab.next_change_needed: Use only after data-quality and PIT coverage pass; broker replay must confirm any discovered policy.
aggressive_lab.role: Discovery experiments; failures are retained as research artifacts.

auto_learning.promotion_rule: No production write without challenger pass, strict target gate, and human approval.
auto_learning.role: Feature gates plus Alpha Scientist hypotheses. Proposal-only by default.

data_refresh.role: Refresh substrate data, PIT freshness, universe, theme, and coverage diagnostics before deeper rebuilds.

fast_guard.role: Fast PR/manual target gap, artifact, error, and promotion-blocker check from committed data.

full_rebuild.role: Manual long-run only; use skip_collector=true and fast_mode=true when cached data exists.

Use broker-trade attribution to separate data gaps from policy errors across the full period.
Improve theme leadership and macro regime features before adding broad cash or sizing rules.
